name: Daniela Amodei
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026); Hurun Global U40 (2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2022-2026)
forbes_bio: Daniela Amodei is cofounder and president of Anthropic, which builds large-scale artificial intelligence systems.
She cofounded Anthropic in 2021 with six other former OpenAI employees, including her brother Dario Amodei, who is CEO.
Anthropic, which private investors valued at $965 billion in May 2026, has partnerships with Google's parent company Alphabet and Amazon.
Amodei worked at OpenAI for about three years as an engineering manager and vice president.
Amodei studied English literature at the University of California, Santa Cruz, then joined fintech unicorn Stripe in 2013 as a founding recruiter.

name: Ray Davis
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2010-2025); Hurun Global (2015-2026); Wikidata (2025)
forbes_bio: Ray Davis and fellow billionaire Kelcy Warren founded natural gas distributor and pipeline company Energy Transfer in 1995 and built it into a giant.
Davis stepped down as co-CEO in 2007 and left the board in 2022.
In 2017, despite protests by the Standing Rock Sioux tribe, Energy Transfer finished building the $3.8 billion Dakota Access Pipeline.
Energy Transfer is one of the largest energy companies in the U.S., operating about 130,000 miles of pipeline for oil and natural gas.
Davis and a group of investors bought the Texas Rangers baseball team for about $600 million in 2010; it's now worth $1.8 billion net of debt.
forbes_facts: In 1991, Davis tried his luck as CEO of publicly-traded dental supplies distributor Healthco, but the company filed for bankruptcy in 1993.

name: Gunkul Dhumrongpiyawut
forbes_bio: Gunkul Dhumrongpiyawut, chairman of Gunkul Engineering, founded the firm in 1982 as a supplier of electrical equipment.
The company has expanded into green energy with solar projects in Thailand, Malaysia, Japan and Vietnam.
His wife Sopacha has been running the company since 2012. She was appointed chairman of the executive committee in 2021.
His eldest daughter Naruechon, an MBA from Boston University, oversees strategic planning and investments.
forbes_facts: He enjoys gardening in his spare time.
